paper_title: Enhanced diagnosis of multi-drug-resistant microbes using group association modeling and machine learning

concerns_full.concern_text: What is the power loss attributable to GAM grouping strategy? Standard LMM detects false-positive cross-associations but may be more powered for new drugs. Must compare power of GAM vs LMM.

Validation on S. aureus dataset is trivial — most regression/ML approaches would identify AMR genes given strong effect sizes. Must compare methods in terms of power, FPR, and total known AMR determinants identified.
Should show PPV and Specificity of GAM+ML model alongside sensitivity. Results presented as sensitivity/specificity rather than AUC would be more informative.

paper_title: Performance of plasma biomarkers for diagnosis and prediction of dementia in a Brazilian cohort

concerns_full.concern_text: Only 34% (49/145) have gold standard CSF biomarker data. How can plasma biomarker performance be evaluated without gold standard for most participants?
Very small sample (N=145). Subgroup sizes unclear. Limited power for biomarker comparison.
